{{Top|legends=Temple of Exar Kun|notoc=1}} {{Conjecture}} {{Structure |image= |name=Unidentified Sith temple |constructed= |destroyed= |type= |location= |interest= |rebuilt= |builder= |height= |width= |affiliation=[[Sith]]''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' }} A '''Sith temple''' was built to honor the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]]{{EncyclopediaCite|Lightsabers and Jedi Equipment}} [[Exar Kun]]. It once contained an [[obsidian]] slab [[Domabesh|inscribed]] with Kun's name,''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' as well as hieroglyphs representing warding spells. It was constructed at some point during or after Kun's [[time]], thousands of [[Standard year|years]] before the time of the [[Sith Lord]]s [[Darth Sidious]] and his [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]] [[Maul|Darth Maul]]. At some point during or before [[10 BBY]],{{FilmDate|Solo}} As the slab from [[Exar Kun]]'s [[Sith temple|temple]] is part of [[Dryden's desk]] during the present-day events of ''Solo'', [[Dryden Vos]] must have looted it during or before that year. the [[crime lord]] [[Dryden Vos]] of [[Crimson Dawn]] plundered the [[Sith temple|temple]], obtaining a stone slab carved with the warding spells and an inscription reading "Our temple honouring [[Sith]] [[Lord]] Exar Kun." Vos had the obsidian mounted into a [[Dryden's desk|desk]] which he kept in his [[Dryden's study|study]] aboard the [[Nau'ur-class yacht|yacht]] ''[[First Light]]''. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|The central desk, which represents the administrative seat of his power, is a bespoke piece of furniture. The stone base, that Dryden has plundered from the Sith temple of Exar Kun, is made from polished obsidian and decorated with carved hieroglyphs representing spells that protected its former home.|[[Lee Sandales]]|''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''}} The temple was first mentioned, albeit in an untranslated inscription, in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', and was identified as a Sith temple in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. In concept art for ''Solo'', the temple Vos plundered was identified as the Sith temple of Exar Kun. The temple's connection to Kun was confirmed as [[canon]] when Twitter user AurekFonts translated the slab's inscription.{{Twitter|AurekFonts|status/1339662884318576641|AurekFonts|quote=Put it all together, and we get a final translation that is wholly intelligible:
OUR TEMPLE
HONOURING
SITH LORD
EXAR KUN|archivedate=20201218011804}} The [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' contains an illustration of a building resembling''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' the depiction of the Temple of Exar Kun from the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|The Temple of Exar Kun|Yavin 4}} The [[2021]] reference book "[[Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim]]," a part of [[De Agostini]]'s [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] series{{EncyclopediaCite|Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}} contains the [[Ralph McQuarrie]] depiction of the temple from the [[1995]] reference book ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''.''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'' However, no connection has been made between the structures. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Temple of Exar Kun]] first appeared in the [[1994]] novel [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']], written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]].[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']] ==Appearances== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1stm}} {{C|in inscription}} ==Sources== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' *''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{Ncm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Temple Sith non-identifié }} [[Category:Sith temples]]
